$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — BuildManifest. Major version 1 (issue #28 coordinator correction C2): the explicit, versioned inventory of ONE build bundle produced by `det build --config` — every generated artifact that belongs in the handoff with its per-FILE-BYTE sha256 (deliberately distinct from the converter family's canonical payload contentHash, which is documented as a canonical-payload hash, never a file-byte hash), the consumed inputs with their byte hashes, the exact stage provenance, and the honest gap list (including the explicitly OPERATOR_GATED preview-installation steps the offline build does not perform). This is the artifact manifest for downstream verification/discovery — it is never a substitute for the caller-supplied content-manifest (a content layer, not an inventory), and it invents nothing: a file absent from the bundle is absent from the manifest, and an unimplemented step is a gap, never a claim.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Build Manifest

revisionId.description: The pinned source revision the extracted artifacts carry (verbatim from the PageStructure; OBSERVED markers stay honest — the manifest never upgrades an unpinned observation).

contentHash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the validated build config (volatile-free identity of what was asked).

status.description: reused = a caller-supplied pinned artifact was consumed instead of re-running the stage; planned = declared but not executed (a --dry-run build validates and inventories inputs without running stages — chained stages consume on-disk stage outputs, so a truthful dry run runs nothing).

outDir.description: Stage output directory relative to the bundle root (never absolute).

stages.description: The shipped pipeline stages this build ran, in execution order.

inputs.description: Every caller-supplied file the build consumed (profile, registry when reused, binding map, content manifest, projection), byte-hashed as read.

outputs.description: Every generated file in the bundle (native content, reports, inventories, envelopes) with per-file-byte sha256 — empty in a --dry-run manifest, which inventories inputs only and records the dry-run gap.

code.description: Open manifest-level gap vocabulary (never a converter-family diagnostic code): e.g. COMPOSITION_GAPS_PRESENT, PREVIEW_INSTALL_OPERATOR_GATED, PREVIEW_ASSETS_NOT_GENERATED.

gaps.description: Honest gaps: composition mapping gaps summarized by class, plus every step this offline build explicitly does NOT perform (preview installation, asset generation, live-source reads) — a gap here is a precise boundary, never a claim.

path.description: Bundle-relative path for outputs; the resolved caller path (or config-relative form) for inputs. Never a placeholder.

role.description: Closed major-1 manifest role enum (additive minors only).

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the EXACT file bytes as they sit on disk — the verification hash for downstream tooling (canonical payload contentHash values live inside the converter artifacts themselves and are deliberately a different notion).

via.description: Which shipped stage produced it (outputs) or that the caller supplied it (inputs).
